T53_same_direction.grade: B - meets the 'B or better' bar, so it routes as a scale-in rather than a C-grade confirmation-only.
T53_same_direction.window_slot: NOT consumed. LONDON fills stay at 1 of 2 for cap purposes.

significance: First T53 same-direction scale-in of the run. The agent adjudicated it as a fresh candidate exactly as the contract says - it did not treat the open position as a reason to take or to decline - and its stop_rationale explicitly mirrored L1's original stop on the same cluster ('mirroring L1's original 29843 stop on the same cluster rather than the candle high alone'), which is the same structural read applied twice 27 minutes apart.
consequence: routed to tv-manage as a second_setup scale-in on the open L1 runner. No new window slot consumed.

found_by: the tv-trigger agent adjudicating w49 2026-06-24 L3 at 04:00 - NOT by the orchestrator
severity: HIGH - a mechanical gate was silently disabled for one whole direction
defect: MECHANICAL_GATE_outer_band_fade_only evaluated the SHORT band for EVERY candidate, longs included.

root_cause.why: `side` is only ever 'long' or 'short'. It is never 'up'. So `up` evaluated False for every candidate, the band was always vwap_m2, the test was always px <= vwap_m2, and every gate note was labelled 'down candidate' regardless of direction.

consequence: correct for shorts, silently broken for longs. A LONG at or through VWAP+2 - precisely what the rule exists to refuse - was reported as 'gate does NOT fire'. That is a FALSE NEGATIVE, the dangerous direction for a gate: it fails open.
how_it_surfaced: the agent noticed the arithmetic contradicted the briefing's own signal_direction field: 'the briefing's own outer-band arithmetic note checked the wrong side (it evaluated vwap_m2 for a "down candidate" even though signal_direction_2m_3m is "long" and the candle closed through vwap_p2)'. It recomputed the correct side itself and passed the candidate on it.

blast_radius.method: re-evaluated the gate correctly for every trigger briefing emitted in this run and compared against what each briefing actually stated
blast_radius.briefings_checked: all w49 trigger briefings emitted to date
blast_radius.the_one: w49 2026-06-24 L3 at 04:00 - price 30181.75 against vwap_p2 30178.53, so the gate SHOULD have fired and the briefing said it did not.
blast_radius.outcome_impact: NONE. The agent caught the error unaided and passed the candidate with constraints_failed ['outer_band_fade_only','direction_mismatch'] - the same verdict a correct briefing would have produced.
blast_radius.why_no_others: in every other case price was not beyond the band on either side, so the wrong band and the right band gave the same answer.

remedy: a driver-layer recompute (fixgate.py) now rewrites the gate block with the correct band for the candidate's actual direction, and runs on every briefing BEFORE any agent reads it. Applied retroactively to all pre-built briefings.
repo_change_still_owed: the two-line fix belongs in scripts/replay_tools/mkcand.py:77 - compare against 'long' rather than 'up'. This run cannot edit the shared checkout.
note: worth recording that a tier-2 agent caught an orchestrator bug that the orchestrator's own checks did not. The preflight, leak and level-set guards all validate INPUTS; nothing was validating the derived blocks the orchestrator writes on top of them.
